modules.title: F Prime mission components
modules.technique: Customer-specific component models, command dictionaries, sequences and deployment integration.
modules.validation: Unit, integration and operational scenario tests.

modules.title: Guidance & navigation
modules.technique: Sensor fusion, pointing guidance and actuator allocation evaluated against Basilisk plant models.
modules.inputs: Sensor specifications, inertia and mission accuracy budgets.
modules.validation: Monte Carlo campaigns and fault recovery criteria.

modules.title: RTEMS energy controller
modules.technique: A separate RTEMS firmware node in Renode, integrated after board and peripheral compatibility tests.
modules.inputs: Power interfaces, thresholds and selected BSP.
modules.validation: ELF boot, clock, interrupt, UART and protection tests.

modules.title: Energy model calibration
modules.technique: Measured panel, converter and battery characteristics replace illustrative power assumptions.
modules.inputs: Efficiency maps, load profiles and battery test data.
modules.validation: Energy balance and parameter sensitivity studies.

modules.title: Verification campaigns
modules.technique: Automated mission sweeps, requirement traceability and controlled regression evidence.
modules.validation: Repeatability, coverage and independent result checks.

modules.title: Embedded software integration
modules.technique: A separable binary library and customer adapters for software or emulated hardware subsystems.
modules.inputs: Target toolchain, timing and transport contracts.
modules.validation: ABI compatibility, timing budgets and interface conformance.
